summary: Re-tested the modified Try-On flow that now performs a REAL Gemini Nano Banana photo edit on the user's uploaded image (POST /api/visualize/tryon-edit). Added /app/backend/tests/test_tryon_edit.py with 5 pytest cases — all pass (401 no-auth, 400 non-tryon p5, 404 unknown product, 400 empty image, 200 happy path with real base64 data-URL result). Direct backend calls for p2/p3/p4 also return 200 with correct microcopy. Frontend E2E via Playwright on /try-on?product=p1: garment selector + upload via file input + Validate & try on -> processing overlay (data-testid=processing-overlay) -> tryon-result renders with BeforeAfter slider (data-testid=before-after) showing the user's original photo edited with the blazer. Demo-fail toggle path still works: ValidationPanel (data-testid=validation-panel) shows BLOCKED with Retake/Upload another and the edit endpoint is NOT called (processing-overlay absent). Switch-garment behavior: clicking garment-p2 after a result correctly triggers re-processing overlay (edit is re-run from the ORIGINAL uploaded photo). In the E2E, the specific p2 call returned a transient 502 once, but subsequent direct backend calls for p2/p3/p4 all returned 200 — this appears to be an occasional Gemini flakiness, not a code bug.

minor.issue: Occasional 502 'No edited image returned' from Gemini when the model returns text-only. No retry logic on the backend — a single hiccup surfaces directly to the user.

action_items: (Optional resilience) Add a single automatic retry inside POST /api/visualize/tryon-edit when the Gemini call returns no image (currently raises 502 immediately). This would eliminate the occasional user-visible failure without changing the UX.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/visualize/tryon-edit uses synchronous requests.get() inside an async endpoint to fetch the garment image — this blocks the event loop for up to 25s. Prefer httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.
Garment image is fetched from a remote CDN on every single call. Simple in-memory or file cache keyed by product_id would make each re-edit noticeably faster and reduce cost.
No automatic retry when Gemini returns zero images (empty images list -> immediate 502). One retry would materially improve reliability against transient model refusals.

TryOn.jsx chooseGarment triggers runEdit(g) when step === 'processing' too — clicking a garment mid-generation cancels/overlaps the in-flight request. Consider disabling garment buttons while step === 'processing'.
server.py still a single ~625-line module. If more visualize endpoints are added, split into routers (auth/catalog/visualize/cart).

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 new tryon-edit tests + prior 25/25 still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 3/4 flows green (happy path, demo-fail, switch-garment triggers reprocessing); one transient 502 on the second edit

seed_data_creation: None — tests use existing seeded products p1-p5 and the admin user. A synthetic /tmp/person.jpg is generated on the fly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint POST /api/visualize/tryon-edit is fully verified (401/400/404 branches + 200 happy path returns data:image/*;base64,... payload with microcopy 'AI photo edit — garment applied to your photo'). Frontend flow uses data-testid selectors: garment-p{1..4}, choose-file-btn (hidden input[type=file]), demo-fail-toggle, visualize-btn, processing-overlay, tryon-result, before-after, validation-panel. Note: BeforeAfter microcopy is rendered with CSS text-transform: uppercase, so innerText checks should be case-insensitive. Real edit takes ~8-40s; poll up to 90s. A tiny synthetic 'person' JPEG is enough to exercise the endpoint but Gemini occasionally returns no image for such simple inputs — a real full-body photo would be more reliable for repeated runs.
rca of the issue: The one-off 502 seen mid-E2E (garment switch to p2) was traced to backend log 'POST /api/visualize/tryon-edit 502'. Backend raises 502 in exactly two places: (a) requests.get failure fetching the garment CDN image, and (b) empty images list from Gemini's multimodal response. Since a direct retry of p2 immediately after returned 200, the cause is (b): Gemini occasionally responds without an image for the very minimal synthetic test photo. Mitigation: add one automatic retry in tryon_edit when images is empty.
